title: Cheyava Falls, Neretva Vallis, Jezero Crater
map_crs: Mars equirectangular (lat_ts=0, lon_0=0, sphere R=3396190 m), USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM; z is metres above the MOLA geoid

texture_tint.note: Grey HiRISE orthophoto (one band, no colour) multiplied by the median colour of the rover-image splat and scaled to its brightness. A presentation tint, not measured surface colour.

sources.name: USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM mosaic, 1 m/px
USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE orthomosaic, 25 cm/px (shown at 50 cm/px)
CRISM MTRDR FRT00005C5E refined spectral summary parameters, 18 m/px (NASA PDS Geosciences Node)
Jezero Western Rim Mineral Maps, Valantinas et al. (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0), 18 m/px
NASA/JPL-Caltech Mars 2020 raw images: Perseverance Navcam and Mastcam-Z, sols 1195 to 1210 (the splat's 241 photos and their camera models)

splat_surface.source: top of the splat: 80% height of the Gaussians in each cell, rounded over 30 cm
